address: 50 Cheyne Walk, Chelsea, London, SW3 5LR, United Kingdom
bio: This brightly painted, flower-festooned former pub looks very much at home in its smart Chelsea location, and the indulgent theme carries on inside with plush dining spaces set over two floors. The menu offers hearty, modern British dishes, with fish and meats cooked over the grill a speciality. In true neighbourhood style, they also offer relaxed Saturday brunches and traditional Sunday lunches....
